![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

In `normalizeCopilotAskResult`, the context object passed to `applyCopilotEvidenceWordingGate` is constructed with only three flat fields. However, `readEvidenceAvailabilityStatus` and other helper functions in the wording gate also look for nested fields like `evidence_basis` or `evidenceBasis` (e.g., `context.evidence_basis?.evidence_availability_status`). Spreading `failureCapture` into the context object ensures that any nested status fields are preserved and correctly inspected by the gate.

```javascript
    {
      ...failureCapture,
      evidence_availability_status: failureCapture?.evidence_availability_status ?? failureCapture?.evidenceAvailabilityStatus,
      method_diagnostic_posture: failureCapture?.method_diagnostic_posture ?? failureCapture?.methodDiagnosticPosture,
      question_availability: failureCapture?.question_availability ?? failureCapture?.questionAvailability ?? 'attemptable',
    },
```
Fixed. The gate now normalizes nullish context with an empty object before property reads, and `copilot-evidence-wording-gate.test.js` covers null legacy context blocking official-certainty copy.

Fixed. `normalizeCopilotAskResult` now spreads the full failure capture into the gate context, and object-form `evidenceBasis` metadata is preserved instead of stringified so nested posture fields are inspected.
